items.title: Is This Pullback In Vertiv Stock A Glitch Or A Warning?
items.summary: The data center infrastructure provider is growing fast, but its stock just hit a rough patch, leaving investors to weigh a powerful history against a pricey present.

items.title: Vertiv Stock Keeps Cooling Off. One Analyst Says a 100% Rally Is Coming
items.summary: Vertiv has quietly shed nearly a third of its value from its peak even as earnings beats pile up and estimates keep climbing higher. One analyst has a target so far above current prices it sounds almost absurd, but the operating data behind it is harder to dismiss than you might expect.

items.title: Is Eaton Corporation Stock Underperforming the Nasdaq?
items.summary: Eaton Corporation has underperformed the Nasdaq Composite over the past year, yet analysts remain highly bullish about the stock’s outlook.

items.title: The Engine Behind GEV Stock Has Real Parts
items.summary: A powerful business engine is meeting a historic surge in demand, but a recent stock pullback forces every investor to ask if the price of admission is still too high.

items.title: Vertiv Stock Nearly Doubled On The Same Projects That Delayed Its Revenue
items.summary: Selling the complete data-center powertrain expands what Vertiv supplies per megawatt, and it also makes a late part harder to recover from once several of its own plants feed one job.

items.title: Top Analyst Reports for Microsoft, Intel & Bank of America
items.summary: Microsoft's AI momentum and Azure expansion support growth, while capacity constraints and competition remain key challenges ahead.

items.title: JEPI’s Monthly Payouts Shrunk as the Bull Market Raged. Here’s When That Changes
items.summary: JEPI's monthly payouts have quietly shrunk all year while the broader market surged past it, and the one event that could reverse both trends is now closer than most investors expect.

items.title: Is Eaton Stock Riskier Than It Was A Year Ago?
items.summary: Debt takes a far bigger share of Eaton's assets than it historically has, and shareholders stand behind every dollar of it.
